# Bess Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Izzy](../character/izzy.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Bess is described as possessing great beauty, highlighted by her faultless complexion. Her features include silky, nut-brown hair paired with velvety, nut-brown eyes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)_

## Personality

Bess harbors a tendency to hold resentments, finding it difficult to fully forgive past offenses. She also aspires to travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001)_

## Traits

- tends to harbor resentment  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030)</sub>

## Abilities

_Not yet known._

## Goals

- wants to travel to Europe  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001)</sub>

## History

Bess spent time with the local children at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where she delivered the startling news of Mrs. Grimble's death. She later gathered with [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), and [Izzy](../character/izzy.md) in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to chew spruce gum. Along with her sisters, she also rushed to defense of [Grace](../character/grace.md) when local gossips criticized [Grace](../character/grace.md) for wearing boots without stockings to church.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. ## Quotes

> "Since Mother is unable to exist without woods and neither am I, what purpose would entering heaven serve if trees were absent?"
>
> — Bess Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P34](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0034)

> "No—not precisely—however my impression is that it signifies heaven will mirror whatever you wish for it to be."
>
> — Bess Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P42](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0042)

> "I have to observe that you show great gratitude."
>
> — Bess Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P15](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0015)

> "Furthermore, Miss Stubbs, if you refuse to do so, you don’t need to visit Fern Hollow ever again."
>
> — Bess Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION” P10](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0010)

> "It’s not something I do."
>
> — Bess Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P10](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0010)

### [Grace](../character/grace.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/bess-carrow--grace.md)

Bess and [Grace](../character/grace.md) are friends who socialise with the local children in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where they gather together to chew spruce gum. Bess also supports [Grace](../character/grace.md) when local gossips criticize her for attending church in boots without stockings, with the Carrow girls rushing to her defense.

### [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/bess-carrow--ida-ashdown.md)

Bess is friends with [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md) and spends time with her alongside other local children in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). When Mary makes accusations against [Grace](../character/grace.md) and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), Bess comes to their defense. She also delivers key news to the group at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), such as announcing the death of Mrs. [Grimble](../character/grimble.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), +10 more_

- Friend of — defended Grace and Ida from Mary's accusations  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P14](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0014)</sub>

### [Izzy](../character/izzy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/bess-carrow--izzy.md)

[Izzy](../character/izzy.md) is Bess's sister. The two share a close circle of friends, spending time together at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) chewing spruce gum, sharing dreams for the future, and rushing to defend [Grace](../character/grace.md) from local gossips when a scandal arises at church.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P17](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038), +13 more_
